title: Start the connectors that can start

cases.says: every connector whose constructor succeeds is started, in order, and nothing is skipped
a class without a no-argument constructor is reported as a ConnectorException
a constructor that throws a checked exception makes create throw ConnectorException, so createAll skips that connector and starts the rest
the ConnectorException's cause is the exception the constructor threw, not the reflective wrapper around it
an unchecked exception or an Error from a constructor reaches the caller as it was thrown, not as a ConnectorException

origin.section: Class.newInstance Lets the Constructor's Checked Exception Escape Undeclared
